name: 01_Lab_distributions_fresh
title: CIELAB distributions: fresh
caption: Within each scan, colour histograms are weighted by visible 3D surface area and normalised. Curves average scan histograms with one equal contribution per specimen. Assumed sRGB/D65/2°; these describe exported appearance. Background pixels are excluded.

name: 01_Lab_distributions_mature
title: CIELAB distributions: mature

name: 02_within_specimen_colour_changes_fresh
title: Within-specimen colour changes: fresh
caption: Thin lines follow individual physical specimens within each scanner. Thick lines show medians and shading shows the interquartile range at each stage. ΔE₀₀ compares area-weighted scan-mean CIELAB colours against the same specimen's baseline, whose change is zero by definition. All scanner panels and both cohorts share the same vertical limits. Fresh specimens have two stages; mature specimens have three. Stage names do not identify plaque pixels.

name: 03_mesh_surface_metrics_fresh_mature
title: Mesh and surface metrics: fresh and mature
caption: Rows show fresh (A–C) and mature (D–F) specimens. Columns show triangle density per mesh surface area, area-weighted median native face inclination relative to the best-fit plane, and plane-detrended RMS height after surface-area-weighted averaging into 100 µm cells. Dots are individual scans; connected markers show medians and bars show the specimen interquartile range. The density and RMS axes are logarithmic; the limits for each metric are shared across cohorts. Common cell width does not equalise scanner resolving power. These are unfiltered scanner-derived topography descriptors, not independently validated physical roughness or accuracy measurements.

name: 04_colour_geometry_mesh_BCG6-4_partial
title: Colour, geometry and native mesh: BCG6-4, partial
caption: Matched scans of one specimen. Rows show saved RGB, neutral-shaded native geometry with a fixed 20× vertical exaggeration for display only, native triangle edges in a 4 mm square, and area-averaged/detrended height at 0.05 mm cells. The height colour limit is shared across all selected scans (±20.3 µm). Lighting and relief exaggeration are identical across scanners; quantitative measurements use unexaggerated geometry. These views illustrate appearance and structure without asserting plaque location.

name: 05_Lab_maps_BCG6-4_partial
title: CIELAB maps: BCG6-4, partial
caption: CIELAB channels derived from the saved RGB projection under assumed sRGB/D65/2°. Each channel uses identical display limits across scanners; limits for a* and b* are ±80 and may clip display extremes. All numeric summaries use the full, unclipped values.
